description:
## Why

On 2026-05-11, OSCAL was removed as "the source of truth" for lint catalogs, profile composition, deviations, and assessment findings (see memory `pkix-oscal-demoted-2026-05-11`). AGENTS.md non-negotiable #5 (OSCAL as SoT) was deleted; #6 (framework/not-policy + per-rule split) was renumbered to #5 and rewritten to drop the OSCAL prescription.

Workspace docs, beads epics, and code framing still treat OSCAL as canonical and need to be brought into alignment.

Rationale for the demotion (Mark): OSCAL is a compliance-document vocabulary, not a rule-predicate DSL. Even the predicates-in-Rust + registry-in-OSCAL split (Architecture 2 / interpreter, ratified at PKIX-ztmr) doesn't deliver value commensurate with locking the workspace to a single wire format.

## What stays unchanged

- Shipped code in `pkix-lint/src/oscal/*` (Catalog/Profile/Assessment-Results/Risk emit and parse). OSCAL becomes one supported wire format, demoted from canonical to available.
- Vendored OSCAL schemas under `specs/oscal-v1.2.2/`.
- Closed beads (PKIX-ztmr, closed children of PKIX-9vnx / PKIX-amgn) — decision-history.
- `DeviationScope` open-ended kind+props bag from PKIX-9vnx.11 (refactor is good regardless of OSCAL status).
- CHANGELOG entries (historical).

## Phase 1: Decision gates (human-labeled)

Each requires a maintainer call; downstream work blocks on these.

- **.1** Decide fate of **PKIX-9vnx** (epic "OSCAL alignment", open, 91% complete). Options: close-as-superseded, rename + retain with supersession note, keep title and add supersession note.
- **.2** Decide fate of **PKIX-amgn.8** (epic "vendor zlint catalog as OSCAL Catalog JSON"). Options: close-as-WONTFIX, re-scope to format-agnostic "zlint metadata vendoring," or split into "metadata extraction" (still useful) + "OSCAL emit" (optional output).
- **.3** Decide fate of **PKIX-9vnx.9** (`check_shape()` API + per-profile aliases). Was framed under OSCAL Lint-as-Control mapping. Determine whether the user-facing convenience API stands on its own or was tied to OSCAL framing.
- **.4** Decide fate of **`pkix-lint-cabf-refresh` crate**. Maintainer-only dev binary whose entire raison d'être is "transform zlint NDJSON to OSCAL Catalog JSON." Options: keep with new purpose (format TBD), freeze at 0.0.0, or delete.
- **.5** Decide fate of **`OSCAL.md`** (13K dedicated doc framing OSCAL as source of truth). Options: rewrite with demotion header + reframe as "OSCAL output support documentation," move to `historical/`, or delete.
- **.6** Decide fate of **`Lint` trait OSCAL-Control metadata methods** (added in PKIX-9vnx.6.1). Options: rename to drop "Control" naming (breaking API change → pkix-lint 0.6.0), keep names and update doc comments to soften OSCAL framing (non-breaking), or both.

## Phase 2: Execution (blocks on Phase 1)

- **.7** Apply beads metadata decisions (.1/.2/.3) — update titles, descriptions, labels, close where appropriate.
- **.8** Reframe workspace docs: root `README.md` (line 145), `pkix-lint/README.md` (line 5), `pkix-lint-cabf/README.md` (line 21), `specs/README.md` (lines 51-61). Soften OSCAL framing to "one supported output format."
- **.9** Apply `.5` decision to `OSCAL.md`.
- **.10** Apply `.4` decision to `pkix-lint-cabf-refresh` (README, Cargo.toml, code, CHANGELOG).
- **.11** Apply `.6` decision to `Lint` trait (rename or doc-softening).
- **.12** Audit `pkix-lint/src/oscal/*` module docs and code comments for "OSCAL is canonical" assertions. Functional code does not change.
- **.13** Update memory `epic-structure-post-2026-05-11-6-typed` — currently glosses PKIX-9vnx as "OSCAL alignment"; revise per `.1` decision.

## Acceptance

- All children closed.
- `grep -ri OSCAL` across the workspace returns only:
  - Factual references to the optional OSCAL emit/parse code in pkix-lint.
  - Historical CHANGELOG entries.
  - Vendored schema files in `specs/oscal-v1.2.2/`.
  - Decision-history beads (closed PKIX-ztmr, possibly retitled PKIX-9vnx).
- No claim anywhere that OSCAL is "the source of truth," "canonical," "the wire format," or equivalent.
- Future agents priming the workspace see a coherent story: OSCAL is one supported output format, not a prescribed serialization layer.
- No regressions in pkix-lint test suite; OSCAL emit/parse round-trip tests continue passing.

## Out of scope

- Choosing a replacement format for policy/configuration data. Separate open design question (AGENTS.md leaves it open). File a separate epic when ready to decide.
- Modifying shipped OSCAL emit/parse code's behavior. This cleanup is framing-only at the code level.
- Touching closed beads as historical records.
- CHANGELOG rewriting.

## Filed by

Maintainer (Mark) 2026-05-11 following the OSCAL demotion. See memory `pkix-oscal-demoted-2026-05-11` for context.
title: OSCAL demotion cleanup: workspace docs, beads re-scoping, code framing audit
